freeze_rule: Two commits and two stages (v3, Codex v2 B1/B2). Commit X fixes the collector code (COLLECTOR_FILES + generator). Commit Y (FROZEN_CORE) writes X into collector.source_sha, every VM-fill field except the three recording_check hashes, prereg.core_sha256 and status FROZEN_CORE here and in the prereg (scripts/pairact_r1_freeze.py core). core_sha256 = sha256 of canonical JSON {prereg without status, this manifest without status and the three recording_check hashes} (harness.pairact_collect.core_sha256); the freeze script prints it and ledger headers record it, it is never stored in these files. The probe source measurement run, probe-cases, the recording probe and check-rows run at FROZEN_CORE and are bound to core_sha256. Commit Z (FROZEN) fills the three recording_check hashes from the probe source run root and sets status FROZEN (scripts/pairact_r1_freeze.py final); core_sha256 must stay the same. Training collection and convert-input need FROZEN. The runner checks that collector.source_sha is an ancestor of HEAD and that no COLLECTOR_FILES / generator file changed between X and HEAD (HEAD == X is not required).
